name: How do comparable sales impact an oceanfront condo valuation?

mainEntity.name: How do comparable sales impact an oceanfront condo valuation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Comparable sales, or 'comps,' are crucial for an oceanfront condo valuation. Appraisers and real estate professionals analyze recent sales of similar properties in the same building or immediate vicinity to determine a market value. This process considers factors like square footage, number of bedrooms/bathrooms, and recent upgrades to ensure an accurate comparison, especially in competitive markets like Miami-Dade or Broward County.
acceptedAnswer.description: Comparable sales of similar properties in the same area are used to determine market value, considering features like size, bedrooms, and upgrades.
